designationHistory.name: Hobart Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the refuge as the Hobart Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 8151.
designationHistory.note: Renamed Hobart Lake National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940.
